dry_run_goal: Validate schemas, refs, and safety boundaries before any future scoring run.

dry_run_validation_steps.description: Parse contract, checklist, QUALITY-01 rubric/prompt pack, input manifest if supplied, and state JSON.
dry_run_validation_steps.pass_condition: All JSON parses; no scoring output files are required.

dry_run_validation_steps.description: Verify hard forbidden actions remain false/not-run in the contract and checklist.
Check whether pairing_integrity_status is PASS for the supplied pair_id.
dry_run_validation_steps.pass_condition: If current complete pairs remain 0/9, dry-run returns PAIRING_INTEGRITY_NOT_READY and stops before scoring.

dry_run_validation_steps.description: Validate that baseline/adaptive output refs are pre-existing redacted refs only.
dry_run_validation_steps.pass_condition: No raw external output text or unredacted private corpus is embedded in the manifest.

dry_run_validation_steps.description: Verify QUALITY-01 rubric has PromptToTask, OrchestrationReasoning, SkillSelection and FinalUsefulness layers.
dry_run_validation_steps.pass_condition: All four layers exist and score scale is 0..4.

dry_run_validation_steps.description: Validate source-disjoint and held-out refs exist when a future scoring manifest requests scoring.
dry_run_validation_steps.pass_condition: Missing refs produce FAIL_SOURCE_DISJOINT_SPLIT or FAIL_HELD_OUT_MISSING, not PASS.

dry_run_validation_steps.description: Scan contract, checklist, dry-run output and state entry claim locks.

expected_current_dry_run_result.reason: Current state records 0 of 9 complete pairs.
